messages:
AcmeProdOps: Hey team — our tenant acme-corp dropped to 0 tokens at 13:17 local and all API calls started 429ing. We expect monthly allotment to refill at midnight UTC — but they were still 0. Can you confirm behavior?
Olivia (Support): Sorry you're hitting this. Quick Q: is the org on a monthly plan or a committed reserved capacity?
AcmeProdOps: Monthly pay-as-you-go. No reserved capacity. We were mid-workflow, not doing any big batch jobs.
Olivia (Support): Thanks — sending this to billing + infra to check ledger and refill job. Sam, can you pull the tenant's charge ledger for today?
Sam (Billing): Looking now. The ledger shows token deductions ~12:30-13:15 from streaming sessions, then a sudden 0 at 13:17. No manual adjustments. Attached short excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T12:29:41Z acme-corp.gen  +230 tokens used
2026-03-15T12:31:02Z acme-corp.stream +1200 tokens used
2026-03-15T13:16:58Z acme-corp.routeX -remaining -> 0
```
No refill trigger on file.
Priya (Infra): Can you paste the API error snippet from the app when it hit 429? Also, which region?
AcmeProdOps: EU-West. Error snippet: `{"error":"quota_exhausted","retry_after":null}`. UI showed 0/10M tokens for the org.
Henry (Runtime): Streaming double-counting bug was patched last month but maybe a variant slipped through. If streaming session closed uncleanly, two ledger entries could race. Priya — can you check at 13:16-13:18 for duplicate session commits?
Priya (Infra): Checking traces... I see two finalize calls for the same session id 73b2a at 13:16:57 and 13:16:58 hitting billing service concurrently. One returned success, second returned 500 and retried — that likely posted an extra deduction.
Olivia (Support): Ok that would explain abrupt zeroing. Two questions from customer: 1) will tokens be automatically restored at monthly boundary if overdrawn due to a billing race? 2) can we do an immediate manual credit while they wait?
Sam (Billing): Monthly refill runs at 00:00 UTC. If a tenant is at 0 due to legitimate deductions we do not auto-add extra tokens beyond the configured allotment, but if there's a duplicate/double-count we can do an adjustment. Please send the tenant id and the two offending ledger lines and I'll issue a compensating credit.
AcmeProdOps: Yes please — tenant id: org_acme_772. Ledger excerpt above + session id 73b2a. We'd like a temporary credit while you investigate, otherwise production is blocked.
Sam (Billing): Acknowledged. I'll provision a manual 5000-token provisional top-up and open a refund/adjustment ticket.
credits-bot: pro-temp-credit applied -> +5000 tokens to org_acme_772 by Sam (Billing). Expires 72h unless adjusted.
Henry (Runtime): We'll also add a safety check to de-dupe finalize commits in the next patch. Short term, Priya — can you add a guard in the billing queue to prevent identical session commits being applied twice?
Priya (Infra): Pushing a hotfix to queue consumer to ignore duplicate finalizers (idempotency check) now. Should roll in ~10m.
Olivia (Support): Thanks everyone. AcmeProdOps — are you back online after the provisional credit?
AcmeProdOps: Yes, calls resumed immediately. Appreciate the quick help. One last request: can you confirm whether monthly refill at 00:00 UTC would have recovered them automatically if we hadn't issued the provisional credit?
Sam (Billing): If the tenant legitimately consumed their full allotment, the monthly refill is the only automatic recovery at 00:00 UTC. We do not auto-top up mid-cycle for overdraw unless it's an internal error — in this case we issued a corrective credit because of the duplicate charge.
AcmeProdOps: Got it. Can you add a note on the ticket about recommended alerting? We want to be notified if token balance drops >90% in 1h.
Olivia (Support): Will do — creating a follow-up ticket for a usage alert rule and adding links to best-practice rate limit and streaming guidance.
Sam (Billing): Ticket created: #BILL-4391. Priya/Henry — please link infra PRs to the ticket once hotfix lands.
Priya (Infra): Hotfix deployed to EU-West consumer queue at 13:33 UTC, duplicate-finalize guard active.
Henry (Runtime): Adding an additional safety metric to console: near-zero sudden drops will now surface a 'possible duplicate charge' flag in the Cost Insights dashboard.
AcmeProdOps: Thanks all. Closing from our side once the billing adjustment is reflected.
Olivia (Support): Marking thread resolved pending Sam's adjustment confirmation.
Sam (Billing): Adjustment posted and refund workflow created. Final ledger lines: 
```
2026-03-15T13:20:05Z acme-corp.credit +5000 provisional (Sam)
2026-03-15T13:21:10Z acme-corp.adjustment +1200 correction (dup charge)
```
AcmeProdOps: Confirmed +5000 visible. All good.
Olivia (Support): Thanks — follow-ups: 1) Sam will close BILL-4391 when refund clears, 2) infra and runtime will ship de-dupe and dashboard flags, 3) support will add alerting docs. If anything else pops up ping here. :thumbsup:
